name: report-npc
description: Fixture registry for hammer-entity-report-find-replace only. The core registry (kernel/Effigy/Map/registry/core-source1.json, owned by hammer-entity-registry-fgd-json) has no NPC class, so the report fixture ships its own npc_citizen / npc_combine_s definitions here. Tests load the core registry and merge this file with EntityRegistry.LoadAdditional; this file must NOT be copied into kernel/Effigy/Map/registry (that directory is the registry worker's).

classes.name: npc_citizen
classes.description: Citizen NPC (fixture class for the Entity Report tests).

classes.name: npc_combine_s
classes.description: Combine soldier NPC (fixture class: Find/Replace class-rename target).
